name: False Accusations
overview: Scripture firmly condemns false accusations, commanding believers not to bear false witness or raise false reports against others, as seen in the commands of Exodus 20:16 and 23:1. The law calls for careful investigation to expose false testimony, emphasizing justice and righteousness (Deuteronomy 19:18). God’s sovereignty is evident even when evil is intended against His people, as He can use such circumstances for good (Genesis 50:20). Believers are encouraged to trust the Lord to fight on their behalf and remain silent in the face of unjust accusations (Exodus 14:14), while avoiding the role of a talebearer who harms their neighbor (Leviticus 19:16).
